newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes lower on producer selling.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes lower on producer selling.

text.p: An increase in trade selling including hints of a hike in producer selling pressed CBOT rice futures to a lower close, traders said.
"There was a big transfer of ownership. Farmer selling and there was lifting of long hedges," a trader said.
The market rallied recently to levels high enough to spark producer selling. That selling plus a drop in other grains values pressured rice futures, sources said.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 400 contracts, slightly below the 424 traded Monday.
Rice futures closed 1/2 to four cents per cwt lower, with January down 2-1/2 at $10.55-1/2 per cwt.
